phone.title: Meet Camille, a new member
phone.text: The album: every member's card, passions, what they can help with and what they look for.

phone.title: She already knows who to meet
phone.text: Lukas shares her love of Petite Arvine, and they can help each other: digital for him, the Swiss German market for her.

phone.title: At the dinner, she scans his badge
phone.text: One tap adds his card to her album. Her bingo shows which square he can tick.

phone.title: Contacts unlock after a real meeting
phone.text: Phone, LinkedIn and a vCard for her address book. No cold messages.

phone.title: People bingo, computed for each guest
phone.text: Passions, languages, sectors: nine prompts using only tonight's guests. Lukas has already ticked one square. A full line? Show it at the bar.

phone.title: Every real encounter counts
phone.text: 3 of 49 cards, and the whole Club gets closer to its next milestone: a round of Petite Arvine at 20 %.

desk.title: For the team: one click
desk.text: rotating tables for 38 guests over 3 courses
